title: rises the moon
lyrics:
[00:11.75]Days seem sometimes as if they'll never end
[00:17.11]Sun digs its heels to taunt you
[00:22.39]But after sunlit days, one thing stays the same
[00:26.59]Rises the moon
[00:33.32]Days fade into a watercolor blur
[00:38.79]Memories swim and haunt you
[00:43.84]But look into the lake, shimmering like smoke
[00:47.90]Rises the moon
[00:54.58]Oh-oh, close your weary eyes
[01:02.16]I promise you that soon the autumn comes
[01:04.66]To darken fading summer skies
[01:12.57]Breathe, breathe, breathe
[01:25.80]Days pull you down just like a sinking ship
[01:30.89]Floating is getting harder
[01:36.08]But tread the water, child, and know that meanwhile
[01:40.02]Rises the moon
[01:46.44]Days pull you up just like a daffodil
[01:51.71]Uprooted from its garden
[01:56.77]They'll tell you what you owe, but know even so
[02:00.86]Rises the moon
[02:07.36]You'll be visited by sleep
[02:14.83]I promise you that soon the autumn comes
[02:17.47]To steal away each dream you keep
[02:25.37]Breathe, breathe, breathe
